description: A low herbaceous plant with bright tubular red-orange flowers that hummingbirds adore. Very easy to grow.
nativeStatus: Native to the Río de la Plata region
ecology: Fills the shaded herbaceous layer, where most hummingbird plants will not flower.
wildlifeNotes: The tubular flowers are shaped for hummingbirds and they use them heavily.
propagation: Easy in shade or partial shade; one of the simplest natives to establish.
